supervisor19 full_census retries up to three census attempts; incomplete attempts append coverage_history and may retain unproved identities AFTER the receipt is serialized, and the successful ACK reports s.coverage_history, s.unproved_history and s.violations at ACK time

changes_from_v1.rule: ACK coverage_history must be a list whose first len(receipt.coverage_history) entries typed-exactly equal the receipt coverage_history (else HELD SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID). For EVERY ACK coverage_history entry i (observation[0]=pid) emit unresolved label COVERAGE_GAP:<i>:<pid>. Union status never clears it. Each gap pid must still appear in the union (else IDENTITY_UNION_INVALID).

Receipt unproved_history uniqueids must be a subset of ACK unproved_history uniqueids (else HELD SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID). For EVERY uniqueid in receipt or ACK unproved_history emit unresolved label UNPROVED_HISTORY:<uniqueid>. Union status never clears it. Every first/last identity of both histories must be in the union with equal pid.

ACK contract_violations must be a list of identity dicts whose first len(receipt.contract_violations) entries typed-exactly equal the receipt list (else HELD SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID). CONTRACT_VIOLATION:<uniqueid> labels come from the ACK list; its identities join the union identity set.
Receipt helper rows must contain keys pid, identity, settled and signal (else RECEIPT_INVALID), so malformed rows cannot surface as BRIDGE_INTERNAL_EXCEPTION.

ACK history shape: coverage_history entries are dicts with a nonempty observation list whose first element is an int pid >= 0; unproved_history entries are dicts with identity-dict first_identity/last_identity sharing one uniqueid; contract_violations entries are identity dicts. Any other shape => SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID.

mapping_signal_labels_v2: unchanged from v1: STOP_REQUESTED:<reason>, MAIN_SIGTERM_SENT, HELPER_SIGTERM_SENT:<pid>, SUPERVISOR_CANCEL_SIGNAL:<signum>

consequence_disclosed: Any run whose supervisor observed a post-baseline non-owned process (including descendants first seen before registration) or any failed identification gap, before or after the receipt, yields settlement.unresolved nonempty and therefore capture4 X6 failure, regardless of parent endedness classification. This is the declared conservative supervisor19/package-v9 semantics (quiet-host prerequisite), not a bridge relaxation; READY still never means PASS.
